title.narrative: Social dialogue for a just green transition in the public transportation system in Bogota, Colombia

description.narrative: As part of just green transition plans, new opportunities for re- and upskilling of particularly female, unskilled workers and new formal jobs have been created through social dialogue in Bogotá’s public-private transport sector. This has produced solutions to meet the demand for skilled bus-drivers for a new electrified bus fleet, while offering unskilled women, in risk of loosing their jobs as ticketsellers, training and a new attractive career path with higher job security and better pay.

title.narrative: Ratifiation of ILO Convention C190 on the Elimination of Violence and Harassment in the World of Work in Uganda

description.narrative: In 2023, Uganda ratified ILO Convention 190 (C190) on the Elimination of Violence and Harassment in the World of Work, marking a huge step forward in combating gender-based violoence and harassment in Ugandan workplaces. The ratification which comes after concerted lobbying efforts by LMC partners – both at union and employer side – signifies a major step towards a more equitable and safe work environment at Ugandan workplaces, benefitting workers and employers alike. Uganda is the 8th country in Africa to ratify C190.
